data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of $1,669.683m. During 2024 the syndicate recorded an overall favourable prior-year development: a reduction in gross prior-year reserves of $128.216m (a ~7.7% release on opening gross reserves). The release reflects favourable claims development and reductions in prior years' loss estimates (notably benefiting the Property Treaty portfolio), together with positive reinsurance recoveries; the year also experienced named events (Hurricanes Helene and Milton) but overall natural catastrophe losses were below priced expectations. Some pockets (notably parts of Casualty and Aviation related to Russia/Ukraine litigation) saw reserve strengthening.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures are reported in the financial statements' native currency (USD). Opening reserves and prior year movement were taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding) and Note 17 'Technical provisions' (Change in estimates of prior year provisions) respectively; both figures are presented in the accounts as $000 and converted here to millions. exact_reserve_text is drawn from the Managing Agent narrative rather than the numeric movement row. Some LOB-specific reserve movements are described qualitatively only (no per-LOB gross amounts provided), so lob_movements entries are directional with null amounts. The field names use 'gbp_m' per schema but amounts are in USD.
